change_summary: Production v1.1 feature-aware Reversal Green classification. Strong/Standard Reversal Green remain actionable with unchanged execution mechanics; Weak Reversal Green becomes production WATCH. Yellow and Normal Green mechanics unchanged. Adds SPXW/QQQ GEX_Features readiness and audit inputs.

definition.purpose: Generate production notification-only QQQ trade plans from daily SPXW GEX changes, using NQMain as the historical price-path proxy.
definition.rationale: SPXW capital-type GEX changes identify bearish continuation and bullish rebound regimes; NQMain provides the 03:30 historical percentage path where QQQ 30-minute history is unavailable.
definition.source_refresh_gate: NOT_READY unless the expected latest completed XNYS ObservationDate has exactly one BC/BP/SC/SP row, required GEX/GEXDelta/Close values are non-null, TotalAbsGEXDelta>0, previous daily observation continuity is valid, 60 prior valid rows exist for Yellow thresholds, and NQMain contains required D0 cash-close history for Prior5D when base_signal is BULLISH. Before NOT_READY clears: create no Observation, Signal, report, plan, or notification. Entry worker separately requires a current non-stale QQQ executable quote at the planned action timestamp. For any BULLISH/Reversal-Green classification also require same-D0 rows in StockDB_US.Analysis.GEX_Features for SPXW.US and QQQ.US with SPXW.GEX_Trending_Up, SPXW.GEX_Falling, QQQ.GEX_Above_SMA20, SPXW.Price_Above_SMA50 and QQQ.MACD_Positive non-null. Missing feature inputs => NOT_READY, never default to WEAK/STANDARD.
definition.base_signal_formula: BEARISH = (CloseChangePct > 0 AND PCRChangePct > 5) OR (abs(CloseChangePct) < 0.1 AND PCRChangePct > 20); BULLISH = (CloseChangePct < 0 AND PCRChangePct < -5) OR (abs(CloseChangePct) < 0.1 AND PCRChangePct < -20); otherwise NONE.

instruments.market_date_convention: ObservationDate is completed US cash trading date
30-minute local New York wall-time bars; roll-neutralized for historical percentage paths
Live/manual execution instrument; action timestamps follow America/New_York

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BEARISH, current SC GEX level is at or below the causal prior-60 median, and current SPDeltaShare is strictly above the causal prior-60 P75.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BEARISH AND history_count_sc == 60 AND history_count_sp == 60 AND SC_GEX_current <= SC_GEX_median_prior60 AND SPDeltaShare_current > SPDeltaShare_P75_prior60
signal_definitions.entry_policy: At D1 03:30 America/New_York, create SHORT QQQ plan using the current executable QQQ price. Historical proxy uses roll-adjusted NQMain D1 03:30 Open for percentage-path simulation.
exit_conditions: TP when QQQ/NQ-proxy falls 0.80% from entry
SL when QQQ/NQ-proxy rises 1.00% from entry
If a bar opens beyond TP or SL, fill at bar Open
If TP and SL are both touched in the same 30-minute bar, SL wins conservatively
No scheduled time exit in frozen v1.0.2; remain active until TP or SL

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BEARISH, current SC GEX level is at or below the causal prior-60 median, and current SPDeltaShare is at or below the causal prior-60 P75.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BEARISH AND history_count_sc == 60 AND history_count_sp == 60 AND SC_GEX_current <= SC_GEX_median_prior60 AND SPDeltaShare_current <= SPDeltaShare_P75_prior60
signal_definitions.entry_policy: At D1 03:30 America/New_York, create SHORT QQQ plan using current executable QQQ price; NQMain is historical percentage-path proxy.
exit_conditions: TP when price falls 0.40% from entry
SL when price rises 0.80% from entry
Gap-aware Open fill
Same-bar TP+SL => SL first
No scheduled time exit in frozen v1.0.2

signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BEARISH AND SC_GEX_current > SC_GEX_median_prior60 AND SPDeltaShare_current > SPDeltaShare_P75_prior60

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BULLISH and the causal prior-five-XNYS-session roll-adjusted NQ cash-close return is <= 0. Feature tier: Reversal Green — High.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BULLISH AND Prior5D_NQ_Return <= 0 AND (SPXW.GEX_Trending_Up == 1 OR SPXW.GEX_Falling == 1 OR QQQ.GEX_Above_SMA20 == 1)
signal_definitions.entry_policy: At D1 03:30 record live QQQ reference. Place/plan a buy limit 1.00% below reference until D3 03:30. If not filled by D3 03:30, buy at D3 03:30. Historical proxy applies same rule to roll-adjusted NQMain.
exit_conditions: If dip limit fills, hold until D5 cash close
If dip does not fill by D3 03:30, fallback buy at D3 03:30 then hold to D5 cash close
No fixed TP
No fixed SL in frozen v1.0.2
Gap below dip limit fills at bar Open

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BULLISH and the causal prior-five-XNYS-session roll-adjusted NQ cash-close return is <= 0. Feature tier: Reversal Green — Standard.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BULLISH AND Prior5D_NQ_Return <= 0 AND NOT(HIGH_CONDITION) AND (SPXW.Price_Above_SMA50 == 1 OR QQQ.MACD_Positive == 1)

exit_conditions: If dip limit fills, hold until D5 cash close
If dip does not fill by D3 03:30, fallback buy at D3 03:30 then hold to D5 cash close

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BULLISH and the causal prior-five-XNYS-session roll-adjusted NQ cash-close return is <= 0. Feature tier: Reversal Green — Weak.
signal_definitions.trigger_condition: base_signal == BULLISH AND Prior5D_NQ_Return <= 0 AND NOT(HIGH_CONDITION) AND NOT(STANDARD_CONDITION)
signal_definitions.entry_policy: NONE — production notification/report only; user may review manually but strategy creates no planned position.

signal_definitions.definition: SPX base signal is BULLISH and causal prior-five-XNYS-session roll-adjusted NQ cash-close return is > 0.
signal_definitions.entry_policy: Buy QQQ at D3 03:30 America/New_York using current executable quote; historical proxy uses roll-adjusted NQMain D3 03:30 Open.
exit_conditions: TP at +2.50% from entry
Otherwise D5 XNYS cash close
Gap above TP fills at bar Open
No fixed SL in frozen v1.0.2

feature_specification.SC_GEX_median_prior60: median of SC.GEX from exactly 60 valid ObservationDates strictly before D0; current excluded
feature_specification.SPDeltaShare_P75_prior60: linear 75th percentile of exactly 60 valid SPDeltaShare values strictly before D0; current excluded
feature_specification.Prior5D_NQ_Return: roll-adjusted NQ cash-session Close(D0)/Close(D-5 XNYS sessions)-1
feature_specification.rounding: No rounding before comparisons; display rounding only
feature_specification.ties: SC equality counts as SC_LOW; SP equality to P75 is not SP_HIGH; Prior5D equality to 0 is REVERSAL_GREEN
feature_specification.duplicate_rows: Any duplicate BC/BP/SC/SP row for D0 => NOT_READY
feature_specification.late_corrections: Recompute only when canonical source_revision hash changes; preserve prior report and link revision lineage.
feature_specification.SPXW_GEX_Trending_Up: D0 GEX_SMA5 > D0 GEX_SMA20 from StockDB_US.Analysis.GEX_Features; causal current/prior observations only
feature_specification.QQQ_GEX_Above_SMA20: D0 QQQ aggregate GEX > D0 QQQ GEX_SMA20
feature_specification.SPXW_Price_Above_SMA50: D0 SPXW Close > D0 causal Price_SMA50

production_policy.environment_record: LIVE_MANUAL for generated plans; forward model outcomes stored separately from BACKTEST

pushover.recipient: Configured production Pushover user key from secrets; never embedded in packet
pushover.body_template: Observation {market_date}; action {action_time}; QQQ reference/entry; TP/SL/time exit; causal metrics; portfolio state; strategy/version; immutable report link
pushover.retry_policy: Retry transient delivery failures with bounded exponential backoff; never retry validation failures as notifications

production_policy.change_control: Any base threshold, Reversal-Green feature-tier predicate, entry/exit rule, proxy method, conflict rule or notification policy change requires a new strategy version.

future_outcome_calculation.source: NQMain 30-minute roll-adjusted proxy for historical/model outcome; live QQQ market data when available
future_outcome_calculation.pending_rule: PENDING until all bars required by the terminal rule exist
future_outcome_calculation.direction_convention: Positive return means profitable in signal direction
future_outcome_calculation.correction_rule: Finalized model outcome is immutable unless source_revision changes, in which case create a revision-linked recalculation

out_of_sample_window.reason: v1.1 Reversal-Green feature predicates were selected after inspecting the available historical sample; exact predicates are frozen for forward production validation.

bias_controls: Dn uses XNYS sessions, not calendar days
NQ quarterly roll gaps neutralized deterministically
Frozen v1.0.2 TP/SL/dip rules; no optimization during repair
All actionable candidates retained in signal-level ledger, including conflicts and unresolved candidates
Future-return columns and leaking GEX_Vol_Percentile family excluded from feature tiers

known_limitations: Historical return is an NQ percentage-path proxy, not a historical QQQ fill series.
Historical statistics are gross of commissions, QQQ spread and slippage.
Yellow has no scheduled time exit in frozen v1.0.2 and can remain open across sessions until TP/SL; changing this requires a new version.
Normal/Reversal Green have no fixed stop in frozen v1.0.2.
The source files are snapshots; live production must use configured database/file refresh markers and current QQQ quotes.
